A blind review found 37 better / 4 worse / 7 equal first rows; the 4 worse share one cause: a declaration whose full name equals ONE query word beats a better match on the other words. The 4: fd "command set execute batch" (expected impl CommandSet containing execute_batch; wrong winner: free fn `batch`); tokio "interval start period" (expected interval_at(start, period); winner `interval(period)`); react-hook-form "resync form state reconnect" (expected useResyncOnReconnect; winner useFormState); react-hook-form "swap field array items" (expected UseFieldArraySwap; winner UseFieldArrayReturn). Prototype 3-4 small variants of the formula (e.g. make P count only when R >= some floor or when |N| >= 2; weight R above P; scale the precision term by R so a one-word name matching one of many query words gets little; keep exact only when R==1 with |Q| >= 2 or...) and evaluate each against the FULL harness (`just rg-compare`, scripts/.repos/.questions from main plus the widened sets; baseline for #108: identifiers 59/59, questions 17/18, members 15/16, Rust fd 22/24, held-out q 32/33, held-out m 22/22, held-out rust 34/36, react-hook-form 14/14) AND the blind-review list of 48 first-row changes (table at /Users/gabe/Projects/monokl/.claude/worktrees/agent-a26b382a3617839f4/blind/table.md and blind/results.json: read-only). Recommend a variant only if it fixes >=3 of 4, keeps >=35 of 37 and loses no harness hit; express it as a formula (no diff). If nothing qualifies, say so and recommend merging #108 as is.
